svg.text: VSERVO-02 | Where must returned energy go?
Captured VSERVO-01 topology + proposed protection boundary | No circuit change or selected device
Finite capacitor storage does not replace a qualified sink or a return-capable source.
Actual receiver, source and harness limits remain unavailable. All examples are allocations.
ONBOARD: buck -> D4
U3 SYNC/MODE pin 17 = GND
BEC_ONLY: J2.2 -> D9
Actual BEC sink behavior unknown
VSERVO / C11 / C12
J3.2 and TP4.1
Exclusive source populations
J3 servo supply + harness
Returned energy is unmeasured.
Propulsion energy is not assumed here.

Proposed VSERVO -> controlled sink -> GND
Bound full-current clamp rise, delay and current.
Qualify pulse / repeated / continuous dissipation.
Control power must exist while energy can arrive.
Alternative: return to source remains held
D4 / D9 do not provide an intended return path.
Existing buck mode is not an accepted energy sink.
BEC, input path and battery acceptance are unknown.
No diode bridging or population change is proposed.
Window: normal < threshold < allowed ceiling
Allocated 5.1 V normal; turn-on range 5.2-5.3 V.
At 5.5 V ceiling: 0.1 V combined rise leaves 0.1 V.
0.2 V combined rise leaves zero margin.
10 us at 0.5 A / 80 uF adds 62.5 mV capacitive rise.
Storage is temporary; energy must leave
80 uF: 0.210 mJ storage from 5 V to 5.5 V.
1 mJ burst: minimum event sink 0.790 mJ.
Same-start reset by sole sink: full 1 mJ each event.
At 10 events/s: 10 mW mean; peak limits unknown.
Separate boundary: C11 reverse voltage and remote receiver voltage remain unqualified.
Check maximum cumulative energy, local and remote waveforms, and ground/contact sequencing. Do not count energy twice.
Next: specify one independent local shunt cell before choosing parts or inserting circuitry.
Preserve 6S, both converters, C11 candidate, exclusive populations and all default-disabled missing permissions.
